description: Transporte Público Rodoviário (Município de Lousada) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Lousada. Timetables, Routes and Stops for travel planning in Territorial Unit 3 of the Intermunicipal Community of Tâmega e Sousa. Coverage: Município de Lousada. The portal shows the English title as "Public Road Transport (Municipality of Lousada)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Lousada. Its keywords include horarios, transportes-terrestres. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
